{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column from string to float, handling potential errors
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_revenue)"}
